description: The chart illustrates the composition of three components—Context, Generated Response, and Other—within two categories, “Ours” and “Standard,” using horizontal stacked bars. The category axis is vertical on the left with the labels “Ours” above “Standard,” and the value axis is horizontal (not explicitly labeled) representing percentage share on a linear scale from 0% to 100%, with segment values printed inside the bars. For “Ours,” the stacked bar consists of a blue Context segment labeled 60.6%, followed by a brown Generated Response segment labeled 31.7%, and a green Other segment labeled 7.7%. For “Standard,” the stacked bar consists of a blue Context segment labeled 23.6%, followed by a brown Generated Response segment labeled 51.1%, and a green Other segment labeled 25.3%. A legend at the bottom maps colors to components (blue = Context, brown = Generated Response, green = Other). The categories are not shown as sorted by magnitude, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the internal percentage annotations.
